name: Mary
bioAdditions: Wife of William Davenport of Fordham; the Davenport family Bible, as reported by the Davenport genealogy, names her only as Mary, 'surname not known', and lists her children Thomas (1682), William (1683), Francis (1685) and Rachel (S1).

sources.citation: Giles, Thomas Davenport, Pioneer, and His Descendants: family Bible entries

searchedNoResult: Davenport genealogy (Giles) full text: no maiden name for Mary
researchLogEntry: Round 4: maiden name still unknown; the Bible names her only as Mary.
